label: First copy step after <DEL> (plus <DEL> itself when L=3)
explanation: Fires almost only at one position: the step right after <DEL>, where the input is the fed-back first original token and the model outputs original token 1 (85% of activation mass). The other main site is the <DEL> step itself in L=3 sequences (about 12% of mass). It is essentially silent during the original phase, apart from small activations at t=1 that hold 1.6% of mass, and silent at all copy steps after recall_idx 1. The position is clean, but only about 11% of these steps cross the threshold. Which ones do depends on the first token (l, o, a, c raise the firing rate to about 4x; restricting to these plus g and 0 raises precision to 0.35 but lowers recall) and on length (most likely for L=9, also L=3 and L=8; rare for L=5-6). Top activations are L=9 sequences starting with l or c, and L=3 <DEL> steps. No boolean rule on these variables gets past F1 of about 0.47, so selection within the position looks graded rather than categorical.
